paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 42b and 55a, reporting Rav.[^1]

notes.text: Both saved Davidson Chullin scalars, 42b and 55a, name untitled Rakhish bar Pappa reporting Rav. They support both folios and that direction, without importing the legal rulings or an identity binding.
